supporting_observations.claim: The alerted account tmp.rwong was created on DC-PIN-01 at 13:42:26 UTC by emma.stone.
The account was added to the Temp-Staff group shortly after creation by emma.stone.

The account name and observed Temp-Staff membership match the stated temporary-account practice, but the available records do not establish the account's full group memberships or intended business purpose.
Before creation, emma.stone initiated RDP connections from WS-ESTONE-01 to DC-PIN-01 and FILE-PIN-01; DC-PIN-01 recorded an interactive logon for emma.stone from WS-ESTONE-01.
A DC-PIN-01 network logon for emma.stone from the WS-ESTONE-01 IP was recorded shortly before account creation, and its logon ID matches the account-creation event's subject logon ID.

The RDP activity from WS-ESTONE-01 is inconsistent with the inventory statement that remote administration is only done from WS-RPATEL-01, but the records do not show that this RDP activity was the method used to create tmp.rwong.

The provided account-related records show creation and Temp-Staff membership, but do not provide a complete account-property or group-membership audit trail (T078-00057, T078-00058).
claims_not_established: Whether tmp.rwong was created for an authorized, documented business request.
Whether emma.stone personally performed the account creation or her credentials/session were misused.
Whether the account received any additional privileges or group memberships not represented in the supplied records.
Whether the observed RDP sessions were connected to the account-creation operation.

Retrieve complete directory audit events and current account properties/group memberships for tmp.rwong, including any changes after creation.
Review DC-PIN-01 process, directory-service, and authentication telemetry around 13:42 UTC to identify the mechanism and source of the account-creation request.
Confirm whether emma.stone was authorized to access DC-PIN-01 and FILE-PIN-01 by RDP at the times shown.
unrelated_findings: WS-ESTONE-01 ran ssh.exe to PROXY-PIN-01 over port 22; this is outside the account-creation event and merits a separate review against the organization's approved-service inventory (T078-00060, T078-00062, T078-00065).
